title: Chapter 506 - 506 Cooperation; Surprise!
content:
Chapter 506 - 506 Cooperation; Surprise!

Chapter 506 - 506 Cooperation; Surprise!

506 Cooperation; Surprise!

Jimmy’s body slightly stiffened as he opened his mouth, as if he wanted to say something.

At this moment, Lin Fan said, “300 million euros!”

Jimmy’s mouth was half open, and he did not know what to say.

Lin Fan said again, “500 million euros!”

“One billion euros!”

Even though Lin Fan’s voice was extremely calm, it sounded like thunder in Jimmy’s ears.

Rumbling sounds continued!

One had to know…

One billion euros, if converted, was seven billion yuan!

This was definitely a terrifying number.

It was so terrifying that it was enough to support the IN Physics Research Institute to carry out several large research projects!

Lin Fan saw that Jimmy still had not replied. He could not help but frown impatiently.

It was this frown that instantly pulled Jimmy back to reality.

“Professor Lin, is it really just any Totamac device?” he asked hurriedly.

Lin Fan nodded. “Yes.”

“One billion euros?” Jimmy said.

“That’s right,” Lin Fan said.

“Deal!” Jimmy said immediately.

“Aren’t you just a director?” Lin Fan asked. “Can you decide whether to sell the Totamac device? Why don’t I go to your superiors directly?”

Jimmy said hurriedly, “Proffesor Lin, you might not know this, but I have a good relationship with the director of the Academy of Sciences. I guarantee that I’ll be able to reach a purchase contract with you very soon.”

In his opinion, this transaction was extremely profitable and could make great contributions!

What if Lin Fan went to find someone else?

Then, would the profits and credit not all become someone else’s?

Lin Fan did not care about Jimmy’s thoughts at all.

As long as he could buy the Totamac device, it would be fine.

Jimmy introduced Lin Fan to the two directors of the Academy of Sciences.

After a short exchange, both parties successfully signed the contract.

Lin Fan then paid seven billion yuan.

[Ding! Do you want to use the random rebate card?]

Lin Fan’s expression shifted slightly as he thought to himself, ‘Use it!’

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a 2x rebate.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 14 billion yuan.]

Then…

Lin Fan’s phone vibrated.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 140,000,000,00 yuan was deposited into your account.]

Seeing this…

Even Lin Fan could not help but curl his lips up.

He spent seven billion and earned 14 billion!

However, to Lin Fan, the money had already become a string of numbers.

It was just very pleasant to see the number continue to increase.

Jimmy and the two directors of the Academy of Sciences were in a good mood when they saw that the contract had been signed and the one billion euros had been transferred to their accounts.

That was because they were selling a second-generation Totamac device.

One had to know…

The IN Physics Institute had already developed the fifth generation of the Totamac device.

The second-generation technology was completely outdated and obsolete. There was no need to worry about anyone stealing it.

In their eyes, the second generation of the Totamac device was just a pile of useless junk.

Now, they had exchanged a pile of junk for one billion euros.

This one billion euros could be used to research and perfect the fifth-generation Totamac device.

This was definitely a very cost-effective deal.

This was a huge contribution!

“Professor Lin, do you want to have a meal together later?” Jimmy said with a smile.

Lin Fan said, “No, I still have something to do. I’ll leave first.”

After all, he was only here to buy a Totamac device.

Now that the purchase was successful, there was no reason for him to continue staying at the IN Physics Research Institute.

Lin Fan took a Rolls-Royce and returned to Shangri-La Hotel.

Although Lin Fan had already said that he would only take the dividends and he would not manage the specific matters of Shangri-La Group, Chairman Li Hui was still very respectful.

He personally waited at the entrance of the hotel and took the initiative to help Lin Fan open the car door. He nodded and bowed, asking about his well-being.

How did he look like the chairman?

He was simply the humblest servant.

He was absolutely respectful to Lin Fan.

This made Lin Fan feel completely at ease as he handed over Shangri-La Group to him to build and develop.

Although Li Hui knew that Lin Fan could let him develop Shangri-La Group on his own…

At the same time, Lin Fan could also completely change the development path of Shangri-La Group with one sentence. Lin Fan could even kick himself out.

Lin Fan owned too many shares of Shangri-La Group.

Lin Fan did not care about what Li Hui was thinking.

Facing Li Hui’s actions like a humble servant, he remained the same.

At this moment, Hao Zhiwu, Nie Zhenjiang, Jiang Chaoqun, and Liu Qianqian walked over from afar.

When they saw Lin Fan, their faces were filled with excitement.

“Hello, Professor Lin!” they shouted in unison.

Then, Hao Zhiwu said excitedly, “Professor Lin, why didn’t you stay on the stage of Barney University’s Auditorium 1 and say a few more words? You don’t know how cool you were just now!”

When he said this, his entire body danced with joy.

It was as if the person standing on the stage to receive the award just now was not Lin Fan but him.

Then, he sighed and said, “Unfortunately, I forgot to record that scene.”

In fact, Hao Zhiwu had pressed the camera function at that time.

However, under the influence of the super smart watch, all the videos and photos were completely deleted.

Hao Zhiwu thought that he had forgotten to record.

He had a lot of regrets because of this matter.

Nie Zhenjiang, Jiang Chaoqun, and Liu Qianqian said, “Professor Lin, congratulations on winning the Fields Medal!”

Jiang Chaoqun sincerely wished him well.

Liu Qianqian’s voice had a different tone to it.

Nie Zhenjiang sounded helpless.

After all, Lin Fan had once fought with him on the same stage.

Now, Lin Fan had won the highest award in the mathematics world, the Fields Medal!

He was just an ordinary student.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue whispered, “Congratulations, Professor Lin.”

After they finished speaking, their faces turned red.

Li Hui, who had been standing at the side like a servant, was shocked when he heard what everyone said.

What did he hear?

Lin Fan won the Fields Medal?

Although Li Hui was not from the academic world, as the founder and chairman of Shangri-La Group, the knowledge and experience he possessed were far beyond that of ordinary people.

Li Hui knew that the Fields Medal was known as the Nobel Prize in mathematics. It was the highest honor in the mathematics world!

Lin Fan, his new boss, got it?

Who exactly was his new boss?!

At this moment, in Li Hui’s heart, Lin Fan’s image suddenly became bigger, more majestic, and more mysterious!

Lin Fan did not care about the thoughts and thoughts of the crowd.

He only said a few words to the crowd before returning to his presidential suite.

Then, his gaze fell on the 700,000 red packets on his phone.
